concept: D: pulse-switched magnetic capture with mechanical pins

tether.route: deck reel to load sensor to captive centerline stern fairlead beyond propeller planes to ROV strain relief
tether.stock_payout: manual; remove from straightener per OEM procedure
tether.stock_takeup: powered slow/fast; reinsert through straightener per OEM procedure
tether.automatic_bidirectional: requires validated OEM interface or replacement reel

limitations: All new dimensions and masses are illustrative
Mechanical pins, lug bearing, shear keys, mount and load path require sizing
Magnet not credited in lift strength
Pulse energy depends on selected module
Current visual lower stop is 65% of unmeasured418mm reference =271.7mm; raised ROV remains wet
